lines: Take flight, I said — I won't come back
What I aimed for was that azure, azure sky
I couldn't yet take in 'sorrow'
'Aching' is what I've just begun to grasp
This feeling I hold toward you, too
is now turning into 'words'
Waking from the wandering of an unknown world
I spread these wings and take off
Take flight, I said — I won't come back
What I searched for was that white, white cloud
I knew that if I broke through, I'd find it
That azure, azure sky, so far I could shake it off
That azure, azure sky
That azure, azure sky
With a sound like it had run out of patience
the rusted old window broke
The cage I'd grown tired of — look, I leave it behind
There's no turning back now
My racing heartbeat, let my breath resonate with it
I kick off this window and take off
Run, and I said I could hold it in my hands
Come now, what beckons is that distant, distant voice
Even your hand, too bright to look at, I grasp it
That azure, azure sky, the more I long for it
I knew I was falling
And still, I'll keep chasing the light
Take flight, I said — I can't come back
What I searched for was that white, white cloud
I knew that if I broke through, I'd find it
That azure, azure sky, so far I could shake it off
That azure, azure sky
That azure, azure sky
